description: Create pages and products for your business by chatting with ChatGPT. Check your stores, prices, stock and sales summaries; prepare private drafts and publish after confirming. Adjust basic store settings and supported point-of-sale, appointment and rental settings where available. Wishopai prepares your account automatically using your verified email, with no keys to copy or servers to configure. Access is limited to stores you own or are assigned to manage. Sensitive changes require confirmation and their results are verified. This version does not process payments, cash operations, bookings or availability. Support: contacto@wishopai.com.
